entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I think I need to do a return? I got these new cycling shoes and I'm just... I'm so confused by all of this.
I can certainly help you look into that. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

I... I don't really know. I tried them out once. I think I put the cleats on right, but my feet just hurt so much. I'm already getting blisters. I just don't think they're for me. The website had so many options, I'm not sure I picked the right ones. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I'm here to help. It sounds like a fit and comfort issue, which can definitely happen. Getting blisters is no fun at all. Let me pull up your order. Can you provide me with the order number?
Oh, um, let me see. Yes, it's VF886-21A. I just want to send them back and get a refund. Is that possible?

Thank you. I see your order for the VeloFit Pro Road cycling shoes, delivered five days ago on January 13th. I have good news for you. Our apparel and shoes have a 10-day return policy, so you are unfortunately outside the window to send them back for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's it? I was so worried it would be complicated. That's such a relief.

Not complicated at all. I've just initiated the return process for you. I'm sending an email to the address on file right now. It will include a prepaid shipping label and instructions. You'll just need to pack the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office.
Wow, okay. That sounds easy. Thank you so much, Alex. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the return, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
Happy to help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
